extractor_notes.blockers: Stryker is a large diversified medtech (orthopedics, neurotech, endoscopy, instruments). The five most-recent 8-K filings are quarterly earnings releases and administrative items; they contain no product-specific PDUFA/NDA/BLA/510(k)/PMA dates, clinical trial readouts, or enrollment milestones. Catalysts (if any) for individual product lines would require sourcing from 10-K product narrative, not from these 8-K exhibits.
